name: BJ Betts
bio:
BJ Betts is a highly skilled tattoo artist renowned for his signature styles of tribal and black & gray tattoos. Working out of the State Street Tattoo in Kennett Square, PA, he exemplifies immense professionalism in his work, keeping his space hygienically clean and providing an extraordinary attention to detail in each of his designs. With a staggering 135,000 followers on Instagram, his artistry is recognized and admired by a wide audience. Booking an appointment with him not only guarantees a stunning tattoo but also a professional and top-grade experience.
